objective: Bring Onu the recovered Insane Scribbles.

description: Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening.  Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes.
Tearing away one page of insane scribbles is all that is possible before a swoon overtakes you.
completion: A chaotic, primal magic surrounds this parchment of scribbles. I sense the work of the old ones in it.
Let us hope it reveals the purpose of the Twilight's Hammer in Darkshore...
